coverage.method: Union of NESTED HEALPix cell centers accepted by the native image WCS and quality mask.

limitations: A unique image is a SPHEREx observation ID and detector with completed measurements from a full native Level 2 image.
Image area is the union of quality-valid sampled sky cells. A cell counts when its center falls on an accepted native pixel. Boundaries and gaps below the grid scale are approximate.
Full-frame image measurements and automatic multi-epoch DeepTrace fields are reported independently. Candidate trial positions are not independent centroids.
Catalog checks can be incomplete. Unresolved includes retained trial peaks that still require additional evidence.
Motion sensitivity varies with wavelength, epoch spacing and velocity. The published injection experiment does not establish sensitivity across this survey.
Motion searches use sampled 5-arcminute patches on a 60-arcminute mesh plus the validation fields. Full detector image processing and sky coverage are tracked separately.

Motion area is the unique equal-area pixel sum on a HEALPix Nside 32768 grid whose centers land on accepted resampled pixels in every selected epoch. It describes common zero-shift support, not sensitivity for all trial velocities.
Catalog comparisons of trial positions are provisional. An orbit requires independent multi-epoch astrometry, and a successful patch search does not establish an absence of other moving objects.
The website shows up to 25 recent fields per detector and 500 peaks, prioritizing catalog-reviewed evidence and nominal DeepTrace gain. The worker database retains the full history.
